name: MITF-M melanocyte gene regulation and UV response
rationale: Members are MITF-M target programs and melanocyte proliferation/differentiation; unlike confusables (pigmentation, melanin synthesis, keratinocytes) the theme adds UV-A/UV-B/blue-light and phorbol ester responses.

name: Cytokinetic furrow and spindle midzone assembly
rationale: Members cover Rho-driven actomyosin/septin ring and cleavage furrow plus spindle midzone and elongation; confusables are spindle checkpoint or ESCRT abscission/nuclear envelope sets.

name: Endosome-to-Golgi retrograde and lysosomal sorting traffic
rationale: Members are TGN/endosome/lysosome vesicle trafficking and retrograde endosome-to-Golgi transport; confusables instead emphasize COPI intra-Golgi/ER traffic or plasma membrane recycling.

core: Inhibitory G protein regulation of cAMP
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members concern adenylate cyclase inhibition and cAMP/calcium second messengers via alpha-2 adrenergic and G alpha z signalling; confusables carry cholinergic/purinergic receptors, PKA activation or cAMP catabolism.

name: HIV-1 early replication and APOBEC3G restriction
rationale: Members span HIV entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, integration and Vif/APOBEC3G editing restriction; confusables are antibody diversification, ADAR editing, or other virus-host transcription control.

name: T cell integrin adhesion and immunological synapse signalling
rationale: Members cover leukocyte integrin activation, cell-cell adhesion, T cell polarity and synapse signalling; confusables emphasize extravasation, dendritic cells or Rho GTPase effectors.

name: Sensorimotor gating, exploratory and grooming behaviour
rationale: Members are behavioural readouts (prepulse inhibition, exploration, grooming, touch, visual, social) with amygdala/MECP2-GABA development; confusables emphasize synaptic transmission, mating/parental or vocal behaviour.

name: TLR7/8/9 signalling to IRF5/IRF7 type I interferon
rationale: Members cover TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signalling, IRF5/IRF7 activation and IFN-alpha/beta production in activated DCs; confusables center on TLR3, cGAS-STING or RIG-I sensing or IFN response.

name: Taste and olfactory chemosensory perception
rationale: Members cover all taste modalities, olfactory receptors, odorant and pheromone responses; confusables are ion channel and pH/water transport sets.

name: Cytosine deamination restricting retroviral replication
rationale: All three members describe APOBEC3-type DNA cytosine deamination that clears foreign nucleic acids and blocks reverse-transcribing viruses; confusables are antibody hypermutation, HIV life cycle or DNA demethylation.

qualifier: PCNA-dependent excision repair and translesion bypass
name: PCNA-dependent repair synthesis in excision repair and translesion bypass
rationale: Members are NER, long-patch BER, translesion synthesis and polymerase switching with gap-filling synthesis; confusables carry mismatch repair, glycosylases, alkylation reversal or double-strand break repair.

qualifier: replicase translation and host translation shutoff
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and host translation suppression
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV frameshifting, replicase and protein E maturation and suppression of host translation; confusables emphasize viral genome replication, capping or other viruses.

name: Chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation in early chondrogenesis
rationale: Members cover cartilage condensation, chondroblast differentiation and chondrocyte proliferation/differentiation control; confusables are chondrocyte hypertrophy or osteoblast/bone development.

name: Inositol phosphate and plasma membrane/Golgi phosphoinositide synthesis
rationale: Members cover PIP synthesis at plasma membrane and Golgi plus cytosolic inositol phosphate metabolism; confusables involve ER/endosomal PIPs, lipid transfer or Golgi traffic.

name: Sulfur and selenium metabolism with B6 and molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine and sulfide catabolism and selenium processing plus PLP and molybdenum cofactor synthesis; confusables add carnitine/choline, glutathione or phenylalanine metabolism.

name: Locomotor and exploratory behaviour with neurotrophic signalling
rationale: Members are behavioural readouts (locomotion, exploration, grooming, social) plus RET, ATF and neuronal specification modules; confusables emphasize synaptic transmission, sensory gating or motor reflexes.

name: ESCRT-mediated multivesicular body formation and viral budding
rationale: Members cover ESCRT, MVB organization and HIV/viral budding; confusables are ESCRT-III abscission and nuclear envelope sealing or receptor endocytic downregulation.

name: Platelet agonist-receptor activation, adhesion and integrin-Rho signalling
rationale: Members cover VWF/GPIb and collagen/GPVI adhesion, thrombin, ADP, thromboxane signalling, degranulation and Rap/Rho/integrin signalling; confusables carry coagulation factor cascade or endothelial shear stress.

name: Social, reproductive and communicative behaviour
rationale: Members cover mating, parental, aggressive, pheromone, vocal learning and observational learning behaviour; confusables emphasize drinking, exploration/locomotion or copulatory physiology.

name: Small RNA biogenesis, RISC silencing and miRNA turnover
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly, miRNA silencing and target-directed miRNA decay; confusables involve lncRNA/splicing, pri/pre-miRNA processing control or deadenylation.

name: Ras-MAPK regulation with phosphatase feedback and RSK/p38 branches
rationale: Members concern regulation of Ras and ERK signalling via tyrosine dephosphorylation, RSK and RIT/RIN-p38 outputs; confusables center on RAF activation and oncogenic RAS/RAF mutants.

name: Mevalonate isoprenoid synthesis toward dolichol and lanosterol
rationale: Members cover IPP, FPP and GGPP synthesis, lanosterol and dolichol phosphate production; confusables are GPI anchor synthesis or distal cholesterol, quinone and vitamin K metabolism.

name: L1 and netrin-mediated axon extension and guidance
rationale: Members cover L1, netrin/DCC, ROBO-ABL and ephrin signalling with RAC1 and axon extension; confusables emphasize ephrin/SLIT repulsion, growth cone collapse and fasciculation.

name: Dopamine receptor signalling in locomotion and reward learning
rationale: Members cover D1/D2-type dopamine receptor signalling, DARPP-32, dopamine secretion and locomotor/conditioning behaviour; confusables emphasize cocaine, ethanol, opioid or neuropeptide responses.

name: Glutamate synthesis and catabolism
rationale: All members concern glutamate/glutamine synthesis and breakdown; confusables are urea cycle/arginine-ornithine or GABA metabolism.
